gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Expressive and a little showy, Bruno Ace SC spreads its open letters out like beads on a thread. Sawarabi Gothic is the quieter partner, a plain sans whose curved strokes stay open and unfussy beside it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-shanti: Distinctive from the first word, Bruno Ace SC has tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. It earns its keep in big, short headings, while Shanti sits beneath it as a modern sans-serif with a generous entry into the e.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-shippori-antique: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open letters like beads on a long thread, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Shippori Antique follows in a monoweight sans, its bowls tipped open like ladles.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-shippori-antique-: Bruno Ace SC is expressive, wide and distinctive. Shippori Antique B1 is its best match for one reason: daylight shows through every curve, so the sans-serif text feels as open as the heading does.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro reads as modern and unfussy, with open curves running through the whole alphabet. And Bruno Ace SC above it glides under the eye like wire, giving the sans-serif text a more striking lead-in.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-snippet: Wide, wiry and a bit theatrical, that's Bruno Ace SC. But Snippet, a friendly plain sans with a crescent-wrench c, keeps a longer passage approachable and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-sour-gummy: Bruno Ace SC looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, expressive and open-spaced. Sour Gummy takes over below as a modern sans-serif, and its wide gaps hold up when you shrink the size down.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-source-sans-3: Bruno Ace SC has no thick-and-thin contrast to slow the eye, just wide, open letters that glide along. Source Sans 3 backs it up with a sans-serif whose lower bowl of the a opens up.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-stick: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open letters out like beads on a long thread, and it does showy best. Stick does the opposite job as a plain sans, with tubelike lines and wide exits that let light through.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-suse: Letters spread like beads on a thread give Bruno Ace SC its unmistakable look. And SUSE, a plain sans with rope-thick curves and ladle-open bowls, can stay at a modest size without losing friendliness.
